components.css: .ds-card{max-width:340px;background:#fff;color:#252728;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dadd;padding-bottom:28px;font:400 16px/1.7 "Red Hat Display",Raleway,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-photo{aspect-ratio:1.7;background:#f5f5f5;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#595d61}.ds-card h2{font:500 24px/1.3 "Red Hat Display",Raleway,Arial,sans-serif;margin:24px 0 10px}.ds-card a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;color:#ae2119;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-card a:hover{color:#851a14}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #bb3027;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The captured public WordPress website supplies the charcoal header, genuine combined logo, geometric display type, red capsules, source composition and native vehicle imagery. Light catalogue/comparison tools and charcoal forms inherit this identity; the dark Sora manager remains a separate staff environment.
keyCharacteristics: Original source layout and authentic photography
Phone controls and readable stacked specifications

rules.name: Source fidelity
rules.body: Preserve the selected WordPress visual world and native artwork composition.

rules.name: Separate manager
rules.body: Keep the existing Sora dark manager scoped to staff workflows.

dos: Do use locally sourced original media and genuine combined logo.
Do keep phone labels, statuses, focus and controls readable.
donts: Don't restore the superseded Porsche-inspired public system.
Don't generate vehicle photos, recolour cars or invent specifications.
